content:
Imports exclusions from the exclusion import file provided in your request and returns a list of saved
exclusions.
Note: This endpoint does not support the network_id  attribute in exclusion objects for import.
Tenable Vulnerability Management automatically assigns imported exclusions to the default network
object. To assign imported exclusions to a custom network, use the Update exclusion endpoint after
import. For more information about network objects, see Manage Networks.
Requires the Standard [32] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
multipart/form-data
string <binary>
The exclusion import file.
